body:
Maybe modify `templates/repo/commit_link.tmpl` ( / introduce a separate template, in case concatening results of two `ExecuteTemplate` invocations in `templates/repo/issue/view_content/comments.tmpl` is too unreadable) such that the last line:
```
{{template "repo/commit_statuses" (dict "Status" .Status "Statuses" .Statuses)}}
```
is a separate template invocation and one doesn't have to pass `Status` if there are none.

Because the `"Status" (dict)` default entries are bothering me the most.

user.description: mostly Rust programmer; using mostly Gentoo Linux and a few others; formerly math student at RWTH Aachen and TUC (mostly researching discrete mathematics); make more infra.

body: also, it feels weird that `Status` and `Statuses` are passed around separately, but can only ever be handled together, and should probably be one (dict?) value passed through directly. tho that'd require some refactoring, and should ultimately contain all the values which should be passed onto `repo/pulls/status`, etc.

body: @fogti I think this kind of change would be better handled after commit statuses are implemented in this view.  `"Status" (dict)` isn't worth cleaning up when it would be replaced with actual data in a near-future change.  I'm also hesitant to bring refactoring of the template, affecting other pages, into this relatively large feature PR unless you consider this to be a blocker.
